notes: φιλαδελφίᾳ is kept whole as In love of the brethren with its case preposition and headed on love, the word the ASV's rendering of this lexeme puts in the noun slot; heading on brethren remains defensible and the unit note records it.

φιλόστοργοι heads on affectioned rather than on tenderly: the head follows the English word that glosses the substantive element of the compound in the phrase the ASV actually wrote, which is why the two φιλ- compounds in this verse head on different members.
The reciprocals head on another under rule 83; εἰς keeps its own to under rule 36, so the reciprocal's unit is discontinuous (one … another) under rule 15.
Both datives are determinerless, so their articles are unrepresented and the case preposition stays with the noun (rules 21, 23).
